description: The CSV baseline passed 10 of 10 offline checks after the missing module was included. That supports technical feasibility for the NLnet proposal. The saved call and funding terms are the next evidence for applicant eligibility, licensing and milestone payment. Payhip’s help index returned HTTP 200 after a separate retrieval was refused. Its direct seller documentation can clarify whether a Canadian seller can activate checkout without upfront spend. Treasury has CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. The feedback feed has five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown.
